Chart: a grouped bar chart with one cluster per SKU (RM-001 to RM-010) and one bar per vendor, showing committed lead days. Blank means not quoted. Figures are from the lead-time table in the earlier answer, re-run here. All 5 vendors have replied.

What it shows:
- V01 is the fastest and steadiest, at 12 to 15 days on its 6 lines.
- V02 quotes 18 days on most lines and 30 days on RM-009 and RM-010.
- V03 has the single fastest quote, 10 days on RM-002, and 21 days on RM-008.
- V05 quotes 21 days on each of its 3 lines.
- V04 is the outlier at 56 days on RM-008 and 70 days on RM-009 and RM-010. These are far longer than the other vendors' quotes, and all 3 lines carry LATE flags.

I did not compare these against the 20 December 2026 need-by date line by line. I only used the LATE flags.
